relevance.rationale: *** WRONG JOIN ***. The seeded id points at a TWO-author 1994 quantum-dilogarithm entry. The document is a SINGLE-author preprint from a later year on a link invariant built from the CYCLIC quantum dilogarithm (arXiv:q-alg/9504020v1). Author count, year and result all differ from the seeded entry, so the join is wrong; id set to null. No registered key matches: references.ts carries this author's later volume-conjecture paper (kashaev1997) but nothing for q-alg/9504020, and a grep for '9504020' is empty. On merits: the paper proves that the link invariant obtained from the cyclic quantum dilogarithm via a particular R-matrix construction coincides with the invariant of triangulated links in S^3, notes it vanishes on split links as the Alexander-Conway polynomial does, and presents the R-matrix as the cyclic analogue of the U_q(sl(2)) universal R-matrix. That construction is the immediate precursor of the knot invariant the corpus's volume-conjecture chapter is built on, and the corpus has a dedicated cyclic-dilogarithm-pentagon file (QOU/QBeta/CyclicDilogPentagon.lean) whose subject is exactly this cyclic object.

keyResults.statement: The link invariant obtained from the cyclic quantum dilogarithm by the given R-matrix construction coincides with the invariant of triangulated links in S^3; the R-matrix is the cyclic analogue of the U_q(sl(2)) universal R-matrix.
keyResults.useForFolio: Primary source for the cyclic-dilogarithm R-matrix that QOU/QBeta/CyclicDilogPentagon.lean works with, currently referenced only through faddeev_kashaev1994 and kashaev1997.

proposedActions.rationale: A distinct Kashaev paper with no ref() entry, mis-joined onto the two-author [faddeev_kashaev1994] key. Register it from the title page.

Once registered, CyclicDilogPentagon.lean should cite the cyclic-dilogarithm R-matrix paper directly rather than only the 1994 quantum-dilogarithm paper, since the cyclic construction is what that file formalises.
